text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I2, to be performed on yearly bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ragab Goada Abo-Zeed tested by eng. Emad 
Abraheem Gooda, accepted by general manager eng. Hassan Saeed Dosoki , approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia: WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes gloves ... etc
Shutdown the trash rack
Circuit breaker of 
 trash rack racked out
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set
Cleaning fluid, rags
Work to be carried out
Greasing the springs (Mobil arma 789)
Greasing of the rope (Mobil arma 
 789)
Greasing the bearing supports (Mobil plex 47)
Greasing the push pulleys (Mobil plex 47)
Inspect the oil of the hydraulic unit & reduction 
 gearbox
Greasing the springs (Mobil arma 789)
